solves.reasoning: (A) impress and ___ 무대=intimidate. (B) 백성이 올려다보며 sense of ___ and distance=awe. (C) Open sightlines allowed for better ___ and control=surveillance. intimidate—awe—surveillance.
(A) stone symbolized ___ and strength=permanence. (B) not only ___ the grandeur=magnified. (C) careful ___ and respect=obedience. permanence—magnified—obedience.
(A) emphasizing their ___ position(내려다봄)=elevated. (B) magnified the ___ of the space=grandeur. (C) wasn't merely aesthetic; it was ___=strategic. elevated—grandeur—strategic.
② invisibility가 오류. 큰 창으로 보이게 하는 힘이라 원래 visibility여야 함. intimidate/elevated/magnified는 문맥에 맞음.
④ rebellion이 오류. 감시받는 궁정 분위기는 원래 obedience(복종). grandeur/strategic/surveillance는 적절.
③ weakness가 오류. 왕을 무대 중심에 두어 강화한 것은 원래 authority(권위). permanence/awe/security는 적절.
glass offered something powerful: ___, 뒤에 내려다봄/올려다봄=보이게 함 → visibility.
Open sightlines allowed for better ___ and control, 안전·보안 보장 → surveillance(감시).
atmosphere of careful ___ and respect, 관찰당함 의식 → obedience(복종).
intimidate=위협하다/겁주다 → frighten.
magnified=확대했다 → enlarged. reduced는 반대.
dictated social behavior=좌우/통제했다 → controlled.
elevated=높은 반대 → lowered. raised는 동의어 함정.
absolute=절대적 반대 → limited. total/complete는 동의어 함정.
(A) rulers look down upon subjects=백성/신하, (B) math and science subjects=과목.
명령하고 복종하게 하는 힘·권리 정의 → authority(권위).
글 전체 과거 시제, Open sightlines ___ (allow) → allowed.
aware of being ___ (observe), 수동태 being+과거분사 → observed.
rulers to literally ___ their subjects, 높은 위치·백성이 올려다봄 대조 → look down upon.
glass acting as a ___, 감시→복종의 결론 → silent enforcer of the power dynamic.
